method: Revision of the first acoustic activity edit after visual temporal review of all original endings, focused ambiguous intervals and quiet serves. No score inference.

review.scope: All 135 original endpoints inspected from one second before through nine seconds after each cut. Thirty ambiguous or extended intervals inspected at quarter-second, half-second or one-second spacing; final recording remainder also checked. All original starts checked from four seconds before through three seconds after; ten additional start-context intervals inspected. Every proposed final ending inspected from two seconds before through two seconds after.
review.limitations: Visual boundary correction, not exhaustive frame-by-frame ball tracking. Short resets intentionally retained to protect play continuity. Complete source preserved.
review.preservation: All original retained play preserved. The sole excluded original window, index 47 (1296.4–1304.833 seconds), shows an empty court while players sit at the bench; neighboring court audio was a false positive.

boundary_review.method: Visual temporal review beyond original endpoint; retain quiet continuation and conservative ending
boundary_review.joined_reason: Preserve play and nearby attempts across short resets or visually identified quiet continuation.
